overlap_notes.testing-patterns: API testing: postman-collection genera JSON collections para testing manual/CI, testing-patterns genera xUnit code tests
overlap_notes.generador-crud: Endpoints: postman-collection documenta endpoints EXISTENTES, generador-crud CREA los endpoints
overlap_notes.api-integration-patterns: Auth: postman-collection CONFIGURA auth en Postman; api-integration-patterns IMPLEMENTA OAuth2 en C#
overlap_notes.security-audit: Auth: postman-collection CONFIGURA auth para testing; security-audit AUDITA la implementacion de seguridad
overlap_notes.cloud-config: Auth: postman-collection CONFIGURA variables Postman para Azure AD; cloud-config CONFIGURA Azure AD en el proyecto .NET
